[[File:Havod.png|thumb|right]]
'''Havod''' was a deep red alloy composed of [[chanlon]] and [[hfredium]] used in the formation of custom [[Starship/Legends|starship]] hulls. The alloy was too difficult to mass-produce, however, and was rarely used unless specifically ordered by the buyer.<ref name="GWNN">{{JournalCite|10|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>

During the [[rawmat shortage of 1–2 ABY]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Kendel]] had one hundred [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyers]] languishing in dock at [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] without proper [[Doonium/Legends|doonium]] hull plating. In order to clear space at the yards, Kendel ordered the processing of havod metal alloy plates for these vessels. Despite meeting all [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] specifications, Kendel's decision was criticized by both [[Harod Crimmler|outside commentators]] and by crewers scheduled to serve on the red-hulled vessels.<ref name="GWNN" /> These vessels eventually became the [[Crimson Command]], serving under [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Treuten Teradoc]].<ref name="Warlords">{{SW|url=news/the-imperial-warlords-despoilers-of-an-empire-part-2|series=The Imperial Warlords: Despoilers of an Empire|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref>
